answer: Cap each newcomer's earnings by the max flow that can reach it through endorsement links from established elders, stepped like a terrace where each level passes only so much onward. Splitting one real endorsement through a prism into a hundred clone claims changes the colours, not the total: a farmer behind two genuine endorsements still collects at most what two honest agents could. A falcon-fast windfall queues at the same narrow inlet. Widening it means earning scarce, revocable endorsements from diverse elders, one level at a time.
